name: V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
funding: Small foundation (2025–2028 plan) with structural funding from the Creative Industries Fund NL and the City of Rotterdam, plus EU project grants.
watch: Founded 1981. Dutch arts cuts after 2012 forced a reorganisation and ended DEAF, last held in 2014.
records_note: V2_ posts annual reports for 2007 to 2025, annual accounts for 2019 to 2023, its funders for 2025 to 2028 and its supervisory board.

name: Mediamatic
funding: Mondriaan Fund, Amsterdam Fund for the Arts (AFK), Creative Europe; non-profit foundation.

name: Sonic Acts
funding: Mondriaan Fund, Performing Arts Fund NL (Fonds Podiumkunsten), AFK, Creative Europe; non-profit foundation.
watch: Leading international research platform probing climate crisis, sound art, and critical earth politics; non-profit foundation.

name: Kunsthal Gent
funding: Flemish Community Cultural Department, City of Ghent; non-profit foundation.

name: KIOSK
funding: Project support from Schleich-Lentz Foundation and Konschthal Esch.
records_note: Its site shows no reports or accounts; three funders appear as logos with no date, and the Kunstensite vzw board of seven is named.

name: CIAP
funding: Flemish Community Cultural Department, City of Genk; non-profit contemporary art association.
watch: Located on the monumental post-coal mining site C-mine; dedicated to post-extractive ecological futures.

name: Museum Abteiberg
funding: City of Mönchengladbach Cultural Department, State of North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW); public municipal museum.
watch: Architectural masterpiece by Hans Hollein; historically pioneered Joseph Beuys, Fluxus, and anti-market conceptual curation.

name: Kestner Gesellschaft
funding: Lower Saxony culture ministry, Region Hannover, NDR Kultur, foundations and 32 corporate partners including Talanx, Hannover Rück, GETEC Gruppe, NORD/LB, Bertelsmann, Deutsche Messe and VHV.
watch: Talanx drew an Insure Our Future campaign over oil and gas cover; none targets Kestner. Partner GETEC Gruppe now runs grids and renewables.
records_note: No annual report or accounts; it names 32 corporate partners undated and lists a ten-person board plus about 30 advisory board members.

name: Württembergischer Kunstverein Stuttgart
funding: State of Baden-Württemberg Ministry of Science, Research and the Arts, City of Stuttgart; non-profit association.
watch: City withdrew a €15k symposium grant (2025-26) after antisemitism accusations; event went ahead on crowdfunding.
why_flagged: City withdrew a €15k symposium grant (2025-26) after antisemitism accusations; event went ahead on crowdfunding.
records_note: Württembergischer Kunstverein lists its administrative board and members but posts no annual report, accounts or funder list.

name: Kunstverein Braunschweig
funding: City of Braunschweig, State of Lower Saxony, Member dues; registered non-profit art association.
watch: Early 19th-century classicist Villa Salve Hospes; pure non-commercial contemporary commissions in domestic scale.
